rules: External betting lines only (Pinnacle, Bovada, HLTV-published bookmaker odds, egamersworld).
Per source: q = 1/decimal; p_a = q_a/(q_a+q_b) removes that source's margin.
Consensus = arithmetic mean of per-source no-vig shares.
Consensus basis = pre-match quotes only; live (in-play) quotes are published but excluded, and a live-only consensus is flagged.
Hotspawn crowd pick % is never an input (see data/961/hotspawn_reference.json).
No verified external line => probabilities blank and flagged no_external_line.

checks.description: Every unverified row is blank and carries no price sources
Per-source no-vig probabilities and overround match the published odds at a declared precision layer (display decimals or quote decimals)
checks.detail: 61 source rows checked (61 consistent with display decimals, 0 need the quote's higher-precision decimals); violations: []

checks.description: Board consensus equals the mean of per-source no-vig shares over the declared consensus_sources (pre-match only; live quotes excluded and flagged) and sums to 1
Pick is the argmax team and pick_probability is the max probability
Every verified row carries HotSpawn links, per-source http(s) URLs and retrieval timestamps
Hotspawn crowd pick % is never used as a probability input
HLTV never appears as a price source on the board
Every quote's published decimal odds derive exactly from its raw American price
Board source rows match their quote provenance (orientation-aware)
Session live re-reads agree with the board (6/6 HLTV directions; price re-reads exact or direction-consistent)
checks.detail: 6 HLTV rows + 7 price re-reads checked; violations: []
